title: The per-window epic graph re-read is unclassified: an epic deleted mid-run still re-boots (bounded)
body: rf3's classification covers the admission graph read. window.go:~326 re-reads the epic graph each window; if the epic's record is removed mid-run (e.g. a fold from a default branch that deleted it), that read fails as an operational error, the container exits 1, and the Workflow re-boots into the identical failure until MAX_SANDBOX_BOOTS is spent. Same shape as the incident rf3 fixed, bounded by the boot cap instead of a person. The classification could be reused there once a mid-run disappearance is decided to be the same verdict.
